messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed an API key with only `embeddings` scope succeeded against /v1/chat/generate during a key rotation window for customer-42. Repro steps attached.

kai: whoa. can you paste the request/response? any headers?

maria: request had `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...` (redacted) and route `/v1/chat/generate`. Response 200, body had model output. No error. Happened ~2024-11-22 08:12 UTC.

noah: deploy-bot shows a rotation job at 2024-11-22T08:10:55Z that swapped keysets for that tenant. Could be a transient policy mismatch during hot-rotate.

deploy-bot: Rotation job job_8243 started by infra/rotation-runner; staged keys applied to proxy at 08:10:56, commit to auth-service at 08:10:59.

ertan: Important: our scope enforcement path has two checks — token introspection at auth-service and then per-route enforcement at gateway. If the gateway validates based on cached policy that lags during rotation, a narrow-scoped key might slip through if introspection returns new key id but old scope set.

sre-oncall: Maria, can you run a quick audit search for api_key_id and that timestamp? use this query:
```
SELECT timestamp, route, api_key_id, granted_scopes FROM audit_logs
WHERE tenant_id = 'customer-42' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2024-11-22T08:09:00Z' AND '2024-11-22T08:15:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```

maria: Ran it. Results: two events. 08:10:56 auth.introspect returned api_key_id=ak_987 with scopes ["embeddings"]. 08:11:23 gateway.request logged route=/v1/chat/generate api_key_id=ak_987 accepted=true granted_scopes=["chat","embeddings"].

kai: aha — gateway logged granted_scopes with chat included even though introspection said embeddings-only. that implies stale cache or fallback to permissive policy.

ertan: We have a known fallback: when policy lookup fails, gateway falls back to "route-allowlist" mapping which was accidentally left permissive for a subset of tenants to avoid outages. That fallback is never supposed to grant chat if token doesn't have it, but a bug (#ISSUE-504) caused merge of route aliasing that broadened allowed scopes for `/v1/chat/*` to include `embeddings` OR `chat` and then normalized incorrectly.

noah: Repro locally: patched gateway cache TTL to 0 and replayed rotation — it fails closed (expected). With old TTL 5s we can reproduce acceptance window.

maria: Immediate mitigations?

sre-oncall: Rolling back the permissive fallback for all prod gateways now (started). Also pausing rotation jobs for tenants until we confirm patch.

deploy-bot: Rollback enacted on gateway pool gw-prod-1..3 at 08:22 UTC.

audit-bot: Note: create an audit alert rule for mismatch between introspection.scopes and gateway.granted_scopes within 60s window (severity:p1).

ertan: Action items: (1) hotfix gateway fallback logic to ensure it never adds scopes a token doesn't have — PR in review by kai, (2) add defensive check: compare introspection.scopes at gateway admission, reject if mismatch, (3) add unit + integration test covering rotation window, (4) add alert from audit-bot.

kai: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pulls/837 — changes enforced, tests added. Requesting quick review from @ertan and @noah.

noah: Reviewed. Minor nit, LGTM after CI. I'll merge and cut a patch release to prod cadence channel.

maria: Customer-42 notified via support ticket #SUP-4592 with incident summary and current mitigation.

ertan: Follow-up: check KMS key rewrap logs too — if rotation writes new key metadata order differently, it can affect token introspection if we rely on key_id mapping. Putting that on security/infra backlog.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread updated if we see any other slipped scope events.

sre-oncall: Postmortem ticket created: SEC-INC-2024-112. Owners: kai (fix), noah (deployment + telemetry), maria (customer comms), ertan (postmortem + KMS check).
